full_prompt_en: A square interior photograph centers a monumental looping gold structure inside a bright, spare hall. A broad metallic band descends from high in the upper-left portion of the frame, curves across the ceiling space, then turns downward through the center. Another thick ring sweeps around the lower right, forming an open circular enclosure at floor level. A sloping gold segment extends back toward the left, allowing glimpses through and under the loops. The metal is composed of subtly varied rectangular panels, some matte ocher and others mirror-bright, so reflections of the floor and surrounding walls break across its surface. Behind it, pale cream walls and a large white ceiling opening give the object ample room. Several small round ceiling lights punctuate the gray upper zone. The floor is laid in wide gray-beige stone tiles whose polished surface catches soft gold reflections near the structure's base. On the left, a passage remains visible behind a low golden run; on the far right, the room continues into pale empty space. The view is slightly low and frontal, making the suspended upper loop feel heavy while the lower ring appears approachable. Diffuse ambient light fills the hall, joined by overhead spots that brighten selected gold panels and the tiled floor. There are no people or readable signs. The composition turns a few continuous curved bands into a sequence of overlapping voids and reflective surfaces, balancing sculptural mass with generous white space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形室内照片以明亮简洁大厅中的巨大环绕金色结构为中心。一条宽金属带从画面左上较高处下行，穿过天花空间弯曲，再从中央向下转。另一道厚环绕过右下方，在地面形成开敞的圆形围合。倾斜金色段向左后方延伸，可透过与绕过环带看到后方。金属由色差细微的矩形板组成，有的哑光赭黄，有的明亮如镜，因此地面与墙面倒影在表面碎开。其后，浅奶油色墙面和一大片白色天花开口给予物体充足空间。几盏小圆顶灯点在灰色上部。地面铺着宽块灰米色石砖，磨亮表面在结构底部附近接住柔金倒影。左侧低矮金色横段后方仍可见一条通路；最右侧，大厅继续延伸入浅色空地。视点略低而正面，使悬起的上环显得沉重，下环却仿佛可接近。散射环境光铺满大厅，顶部点灯又提亮部分金属板和石砖地面。没有人物或可读标牌。构图把少数连续曲带变成一串重叠空洞与反光表面，以雕塑重量平衡宽阔白色空间。
style_prompt_en: Photography explores continuous curved bands, layered openings, and broad reflective planes within pale negative space. Give warm gold surfaces small tonal changes between satin ocher and mirror-bright yellow, so reflections become broken color patches rather than uniform gloss. A low frontal angle reveals thickness, overlap, and the depth between upper and lower loops. Soft ambient illumination can be punctuated by small overhead highlights, with subdued reflections on a cool gray-beige base. Keep surrounding color minimal and edges clean so the movement of the main curves remains legible. Repeated rectangular seams or tiles add scale without making the surface busy. The transferable effect is luxurious yet restrained, built from interlocking voids, controlled specular light, warm-cool material contrast, and generous breathing room.
style_prompt_zh: 摄影探索浅色留白中的连续曲带、层叠开口与宽阔反光平面。让暖金表面在缎面赭黄与镜亮黄色之间有细微明暗差，使倒影变成破碎色斑而非均匀光泽。低位正面角度显出厚度、重叠以及上下环带之间的纵深。柔和环境光可由少数顶部亮点打破，在冷灰米色基面上留下低调倒影。周围颜色尽量少，边缘干净，使主曲线的运动易于辨认。重复矩形接缝或砖块提供尺度，而不使表面杂乱。可迁移的效果华丽却克制，来自嵌合空洞、受控镜面光、冷暖材质反差和宽裕呼吸空间。
theme_en: A monumental looping gold structure inside a pale stone hall
theme_zh: 浅石大厅内一座巨大的环绕金色结构
name: Hans Hollein
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
